verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him after his adultery with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your great compassion, blot out my transgressions.

segments.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him after his adultery with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your great compassion, blot out my transgressions.

verses.text: Wash me clean of my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.

segments.text: Wash me clean of my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.text: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.

segments.text: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.

verses.text: Against You, You only, have I sinned and done what is evil in Your sight, so that You may be proved right when You speak and blameless when You judge.

segments.text: Against You, You only, have I sinned and done what is evil in Your sight, so that You may be proved right when You speak and blameless when You judge.

verses.text: Surely I was brought forth in iniquity; I was sinful when my mother conceived me.

segments.text: Surely I was brought forth in iniquity; I was sinful when my mother conceived me.

verses.text: Surely You desire truth in the inmost being; You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

segments.text: Surely You desire truth in the inmost being; You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

verses.text: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

segments.text: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

verses.text: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.

segments.text: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.

verses.text: Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities.

segments.text: Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities.

verses.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

segments.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

verses.text: Cast me not away from Your presence; take not Your Holy Spirit from me.

segments.text: Cast me not away from Your presence; take not Your Holy Spirit from me.

verses.text: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.

segments.text: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.

verses.text: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.

segments.text: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.

verses.text: Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.

segments.text: Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.

verses.text: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.

segments.text: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.

verses.text: For You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; You take no pleasure in burnt offerings.

segments.text: For You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; You take no pleasure in burnt offerings.

verses.text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.

segments.text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.

verses.text: In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.

segments.text: In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.text: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.

segments.text: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.
